mission_04: Feature selection removes irrelevant or redundant features to improve model performance, reduce overfitting, and speed up training. Variance Threshold is the simplest feature selection method: it removes features whose variance falls below a threshold. Low-variance features carry little information since they are nearly constant across samples. In this mission, you will apply VarianceThreshold to identify and remove near-constant features, learning how to evaluate feature variance and interpret the selection results.
